presets.label: Calm climb
presets.description: A steady, low-activity signal for a full minute: high alpha, little 13-30 Hz power.

presets.label: Rising tension
presets.description: The signal tightens slowly from low to high activity over a minute. Muscle activity is part of this signal.

presets.label: Jaw clench bursts
presets.description: Four-second bursts of jaw clenching with rests between. Muscle activity is a large part of this signal.

presets.label: Mixed climb
presets.description: Low activity for twenty seconds, then rising tension, then settling again: the whole range in one run.

presets.label: Poor contact
presets.description: A noisy electrode: signal quality drops, so the effects ease back to neutral instead of reacting.
